paper.title: Look Before You Move: Agent-Interface-Aligned Supervision for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
paper.central_claim: Collecting teacher actions directly in the deployed skill interface, with active-vision teacher behavior and spatial reasoning supervision, improves VLM mobile manipulation (71.76% OWMM), transfers to a physical robot (38%), and supports navigation.

evidence.quote: the teacher \pi_{T} uses privileged simulator state z_{t} to select a skill and its argument
evidence.support_explanation: Teacher uses masks/poses/path oracle; not a frontier LLM generating its own labels.

evidence.quote: Privileged simulator information is excluded from the prompt in both training and inference.
evidence.support_explanation: Student generates reasoning from deployment observations, not oracle inputs.

evidence.quote: collection attempts cover 13,608 episodes, of which 11,740 succeed. Removing 1,528 successful episodes longer than 16 steps leaves 10,212 episodes and 67,183 training examples.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicit acceptance and long-trajectory selection; successful data not all attempts.

evidence.quote: AIDA: distance-greedy 28,480 46.3% AIDA: visibility-aware 28,480 65.5% AIDA: target recovery 28,480 69.6%
evidence.support_explanation: Fixed-data-size teacher comparison provides targeted active-vision evidence.

evidence.quote: We train the three AIDA students with the same seed and report mean success over three evaluations of the 170 episodes.
evidence.support_explanation: Repeat evaluations but only one training seed and no spread/CI.

evidence.quote: Every stage None No 55.88% Search only None No 60.00% Search only Actions No 65.88% Search only Actions Yes 71.76%
evidence.support_explanation: Cumulative harness stack; does not isolate interactions or all leave-one-out effects.

evidence.quote: we evaluate on 170 held-out episodes in pre-mapped simulated homes.
evidence.support_explanation: Simulation test split exists; premapping/localization remain assumptions.

evidence.quote: The robot achieves 38% end-to-end success with a 15-step horizon, including low-level grasp failures in the evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: Physical rate reported but no real per-task trial counts in supplied text.

evidence.quote: The OWMM simulator abstracts contact-rich grasping, slip, force control, and recovery
We map the office with FAST-LIO2 [ 51 ] and manually select 15 scene key frames.
evidence.support_explanation: Real deployment includes manually curated mapping/key-frame setup.
Navigation independently trained from pipeline versus actual OWMM zero-shot transfer distinguished.
Training hyperparameters disclosed, not complete teacher/training/inference resource cost.

evidence.quote: For object pickup during collection, the target must be within 1.0 m with a visible mask exceeding 100 pixels; the teacher uses the 15^{\circ} bearing threshold to align its view.
In simulation, grasping is simplified: the object is attached to the gripper when the end effector is within the configured grasp distance.
evidence.support_explanation: Closed-loop simulation endpoint has configured execution semantics.

evidence.quote: Results for OWMM-VLM-38B, OWMM-VLM-8B, GPT-4o+PIVOT, and GPT-4o+RoboPoint are taken from OWMM-Agent
evidence.support_explanation: Headline comparison changes backbone and source, not clean causal evidence.

claims.setting: 170 OWMM held-out episodes; four skills in teacher comparison, five in main.
claims.baseline_control: Same Qwen3-VL-8B LoRA/executors/harness for three equal-sized teacher datasets; trajectory baseline 152,478 examples.
claims.selection_vs_test: Success/length-filtered demonstrations versus held-out student evaluation.
claims.result_denominator: 46.3→65.5→69.6% at 28,480 examples; means of 3 evaluations ×170. Main 71.76% on 170.

claims.allowed_conclusion: Author experiments support active-vision demonstration value under this skill interface.

claims.text: Simulation-trained student transfers to real mobile manipulation and navigation.
claims.setting: Atribot office, 15 manually selected frames; EB 60 episodes per base/common split with two runs.
claims.baseline_control: Real no paired baseline; EB hosted agents share interface but differ in training/model.
claims.selection_vs_test: OWMM-trained zero-shot EB distinct from EB-trained model; no additional physical training.
claims.result_denominator: Physical 38% without task trial counts; EB OWMM-trained 0.55 versus EB-trained 0.84.
counterevidence: Physical denominator absent; simplified sim grasp; short navigation tasks.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Simulation-to-real feasibility reported, but strict counted-transfer label not established; simulation held-out navigation evidence available.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported closed-loop OWMM and teacher-sensitivity results support privileged skill-aligned active-vision training; real and cross-task results suggest utility but do not establish denominator-complete physical transfer or broad open-world reliability.
unresolved: Strict transfer requires real task denominators or clearly construction-unseen scene/body split; absent here.
EB zero-shot uses shared high-level navigation family; no documented construction-unused embodiments.
No frontier teacher claimed; scope retained because trained VLM skill-calling harness is explicit, not pure VLA.

G.reason: Concrete active-vision versus trajectory-label residual, with relabeled and teacher-policy comparisons; nearest-neighbour originals not supplied.

M.reason: Direct skill-aligned collection, explicit oracle information boundary and visibility/recovery rules target the stated defect. Out-of-view oracle reasoning identifiability remains untested.

X.reason: Teacher rules, success/length filtering, stored examples, shared prompt and SFT/deployment are reconstructible. Full prompts/skill robustness and observable-label identifiability not fully established.

measurement.reason: 170 simulated held-out episodes have explicit full transfer/stage endpoint and repeat means. Real 38% lacks task denominators, so mixed central sim/real claim meets v2 partial-denominator ceiling.

causality.reason: Equal 28,480-example teacher variants with same model/executor strongly support active-vision effect; main 71.76 versus earlier systems changes model/data/turn skill, and harness stack is cumulative.

holdout.reason: Held-out OWMM and zero-shot OWMM→EB evidence support scope beyond training tasks; real rate lacks per-task counts and teacher privilege identifiability/scene independence incompletely audited.

statistics.reason: Three teacher-study evaluations and two EB runs with episode counts, plus failure-category discussion; no CIs or training-seed spread, real counts absent.

cost.reason: Example counts, epochs and horizons provided, but no end-to-end collection/training/inference wall time, tokens or compute-priced matched efficiency.
